name: otelflow
description: Version-aware validation for OpenTelemetry Collector configurations — entirely offline, powered by the OTelFlow registry and validation engine.

commands.title: OTelFlow: Select collector version and distribution

otelflow.collectorVersion.description: Collector version to validate against (e.g. 0.157.0). Empty means the registry's default (the newest supported version).

scripts.build:wasm: sh -c 'cd .. && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o vscode/dist/validate.wasm ./cmd/wasm && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" vscode/dist/wasm_exec.js 2>/dev/null || cp "$(go env GOROOT)/misc/wasm/wasm_exec.js" vscode/dist/wasm_exec.js'
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:wasm
